note: Misreads the take_guide counts as how often he swings (the tool says it compares kinds of pitch), and covers only 0-2 without addressing his 33% chase rate or two-strike approach.
No per-pitch whiff data was provided; naming the splitter as the strikeout pitch and crediting its 'movement' is invented, and 12.6% is his overall whiff rate.
Says to avoid 'any other pitch toward a corner', but the tool lists sinker letter-high toward a corner as the second-best pitch.
Minor rounding: 0.5575 x 190 = 105.9 cm, given as about 106.0; the ~11 cm difference is correct.
